blind_spots.what: a model the vendor announced that our accounts' catalogs do not list yet
blind_spots.reason: Vendors roll models out in stages, Pro plans first (Sol 6.1 on 2026-09-29); the doctor reads only the catalogs our accounts are served, so an announced model none of them lists leaves no trace
blind_spots.would_catch_if: a release-notes feed, or a weekly research leg per vendor, compared announced ids with the served catalogs

blind_spots.what: a Claude model or capability the CLI serves that no catalog lists
blind_spots.reason: The Claude CLI exposes no model catalog; only its help text and the model ids in its binary are fingerprinted
blind_spots.would_catch_if: the Claude CLI exposed a model list, or the served model were read from modelUsage of real runs

blind_spots.what: a codex model served to an account whose home another client version wrote
blind_spots.reason: The codex catalog facet merges only the homes written by the installed client version; a home another client wrote is left out
blind_spots.would_catch_if: every account's home were refreshed by the installed client before the fingerprint, or the facet kept each home's list apart
